name: Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists
summary: A Chicago non-profit media organisation founded in 1945 by Manhattan Project scientists: it publishes expert journalism on nuclear risk, climate change, biological threats and AI on its open website and in a bimonthly magazine, carries the Federation of American Scientists' Nuclear Notebook, sets the Doomsday Clock each January, and runs webinars, events and fellowships for early-career writers.
